title: Uniform annihilation of high Tor against every ideal-power quotient
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof represents derived tensor with ideal powers as cohomology on the blowup. A bounded spectral sequence assembles sheafwise annihilators into a uniform global exponent, independent of the module, homological degree and power of the ideal. The uniformity and filtration control remain substantive after the local blowup estimates.
